# Idea

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An idea about something to explore curiosity, research interests, support areas, or identify opporuntities.

## Scope note

Framed as a distillation from Spark, Concept, and Interest, and explicityl distinguished from Focus (priority flag, not a content type).
